25616:
Édgar Filiberto Ramírez Arellano (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈeðɣaɾ raˈmiɾes], born 25 March 1977) is a Venezuelan actor.

After studying communications at the Andrés Bello Catholic University, Ramírez worked in media and considered becoming a diplomat. When filmmaker Guillermo Arriaga praised a short film he had done, he decided to pursue his performing hobby as a career. 

Ramírez played a CIA assassin in the action-thriller film The Bourne Ultimatum (2007). His portrayal of Carlos the Jackal in the 2010 biopic television miniseries Carlos won him the César Award for Most Promising Actor and nominations for a Golden Globe and Emmy Award for Best Actor.
67600: Ashley Michelle Tisdale-French (née Tisdale; born July 2, 1985) is an American actress, singer, and producer. Ashley Michelle French (née Tisdale) is from West Deal, New Jersey. During her childhood, she appeared in more than 100 TV advertisements and had roles in theatre and television shows. In 2004, she was cast as Maddie Fitzpatrick in Disney Channel's The Suite Life of Zack & Cody, and rose to prominence in 2006 as Sharpay Evans in the television film High School Musical. The High School Musical series included three films and the spin-off Sharpay's Fabulous Adventure (2011). Tisdale's resultant popularity led her to sign a record deal with Warner Bros. Records in 2006.
85008: Sul Kyung-gu (born May 14, 1967) is a Grand Bell Award, Golden Space Needle Award, and Bratislava International Film Festival Best Actor winning South Korean actor. He studied film and theater at Hanyang University and upon graduation took part in mostly theatrical productions. After transitioning into film, Sol is best known for his roles in the popular Public Enemy and Silmido.
123408:
Lee Na Young is a South Korean actress, best known for her leading roles in TV Series “Ruler of Your Own World” (2002) and “Ireland” (2004). She is also known for her leading roles in “Someone Special” (2004), “Maundy Thursday” (2006), and “Romance is a Bonus Book” (2019). Aside from acting, Lee is also known for appearing in numerous commercials.

Lee married actor Won Bin on May 30, 2015, in a private small ceremony in a wheat field near an inn in Won Bin's hometown, Jeongseon County, Gangwon Province, South Korea. The couple belong to the same talent agency (Eden 9) and reportedly began dating in August 2012 (though Eden 9 only confirmed the relationship in July 2013).
123664: Kim Min-hee (김민희, born 1 March 1982) is a South Korean actress and former fashion model. In 2017, she won the Silver Bear for Best Actress at the Berlin International Film Festival for her performance in Hong Sang-soo's film On the Beach at Night Alone (2017). She is known as one of the muses of director Hong Sang-soo and gained international recognition in her leading role in auteur Park Chan-wook's film The Handmaiden (2016).
584464:
Suhasini Maniratnam (born August 15, 1961) is an Indian actress, director, and screenwriter who works across Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada cinema.

Trained in cinematography at the Film and Television Institute of Tamil Nadu, she made her acting debut in J. Mahendran's Tamil film Nenjathai Killathe (1980). She established herself as a lead actress through the 1980s across South Indian film industries, appearing in titles including Palaivana Solai (1981), Gopurangal Saivathillai (1982), Koodevide?
1209616:
Chemban Vinod Jose is an Indian film actor and screen writer, best known for his work in Malayalam films. He's a physiotherapist by profession.

He made his debut with the crime film Nayakan (2010). He's best known for his performances in Amen (2013), Tamaar Padaar (2014), Sapthamashree Thaskaraha (2014), Iyobinte Pusthakam (2014), Kohinoor (2015) and Oru Second Class Yathra (2015). His debut in screen writing will be the 2017 Release Angamaly Diaries Directed by Lijo Jose Pellissery and produced by Friday Film House.
1254672: Asami Seto is a Japanese voice actress affiliated with StarCrew. She was formerly affiliated with Sigma Seven. She made her debut in the television anime Hourou Musuko.
1378576: Mahalakshmi is an Indian film actress in the Kannada film industry as well as Tamil, Malayalam and Telugu industries. She is daughter of Yesteryear acting couples AVM Rajan and Pushpalatha
1619216: Ranjit Mallick is an Indian actor who works mainly in Bengali cinema. He has worked in movies like Interview, Guru Dakshina, Amader Songsar, Sathi, Love Marriage, Premer Kahini, Indrajit, Shatru, Jiban Niye Khela, Nabab, Nater Guru and Bajimat. Actress Koel Mallick is his daughter.
1825808: Bellamkonda Sreenivas is an Indian film actor and model.
1882128: Rahul Ramakrishna is an Indian Telugu-language, journalist, actor and writer. After discontinuing his engineering in 3rd year, he worked as a journalist in a evening daily, Post Noon, and Metro India. He also worked as a translator for national media journalists and a Swedish newspaper. He also wrote movie reviews for Hindustan Times website. He started his film career in theater. He made his debut with TV short film, Sainma.
